title: profiles.relationships
description: Payload for the profiles.relationships comm Function — the fleet's server-side block check. Ask about a page of pairs at once; the answer is {"blocked": [[a, b], ...]} listing the pairs that have a block between them IN EITHER DIRECTION, echoed in the order and orientation they were asked. A block is stored as an intent (who blocked whom) and answered as an effect (these two must not reach each other): the direction is deliberately absent from the answer so that no consumer can disclose to the blocked party that they are blocked. Over PROFILES_PAIRS_MAX pairs (default 500), or on an id that cannot name a user, the call RAISES rather than answering a short or optimistic list — a check that cannot run must not read as 'allowed'.

pairs.description: Pairs of user ids to check. A pair of somebody with themselves is dropped (nobody can block themselves); a pair asked twice, in either orientation, is answered once.
